title: CDC WONDER D76 county-year drug-overdose deaths (rich, scraped)
description: Full county × year × ICD-underlying-cause grid scraped from CDC WONDER's UCD interactive form. Source: pipeline/src/openarcos_pipeline/sources/cdc_wonder_scraper.py. Drug/alcohol-induced causes D1-D4 maps to ICD-10 X40-X44 + X60-X64 + X85 + Y10-Y14. Suppressed cells (NCHS ≤9 rule under 42 USC 242m(d)) preserved as deaths=null, suppressed=true. Unreliable-rate cells (NCHS ≤20 rule) preserved as unreliable=true with crude_rate=null.

allOf.description: Suppressed cells never carry a numeric death count.

methodology.description: Human-readable description of the query (ICD codes, years, group-by, suppression regime).

source.description: CDC WONDER Underlying Cause of Death 1999-2020 landing URL.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the scrape run that produced these records.
